deskyard wait: pause for a while

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] wait SECONDS

Pauses for SECONDS, e.g. for a page or app to load before the next screenshot.

Arguments:
  SECONDS    number      required  how long

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard wait 2

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
